## E. Merge notes for services/core/api/openapi.yaml

- **New tags:** none (`identity` exists). New components: parameters `AssociationId`, `ApplicationId`, `FilingId`, `ExtractId`, `ApplicationStateFilter`; responses `NotOperator`, `MemberOrDisabled`, `ExtractFile`; the examples and schemas of this delta (`Membership*`, `Application*`, `ExtractRef`, `ExtractCheck`, `NewExtractCheck`, `ReviewWarning*`, `Approve/RejectApplicationRequest`, `OperatorAssociation*`, `DisableAssociationRequest`, `AssociationState*`, `AssociationEvent*`, `AssociationCard`, `StorageConnection`, `CompleteStorageConnectionRequest`, enums `ApplicationKind`, `ApplicationState`, `DecisionOutcome`, `BoardPosition`, `ReviewWarningKind`).
- **Changed repo components:**
  - `Principal` → `{account_id, email, is_operator}`; `board_member_id`, `full_name`, `association` move to `Membership` (ADR-0004). The web app reads the association from the route `/o/$associationId` and `listMemberships`.
  - `getSession` loses its 403; `completeSignIn` loses its 403 `NotCurrentMember` (any verified person gets a session, ADR-0004) and its description changes.
  - `BoardMember` gains `position: BoardPosition` and `decision_id: [uuid, null]` (data-model, ADR-0006); `BoardMemberInput` is unchanged (the board adds `member`s; `head` is set only by an approval).
- **Path move (ADR-0002), mechanical:** every `governance` operation `/governance/<rest>` becomes `/governance/associations/{association_id}/<rest>` and every `finance` operation `/finance/<rest>` becomes `/finance/associations/{association_id}/<rest>`; each gains `- $ref: "#/components/parameters/AssociationId"`, and every one of them answers `403 NotCurrentMember` the same way for a missing association. Operations that stay unscoped: `/system/health`, `/identity/sign-in`, `/identity/sign-in/callback`, `/identity/sign-out`, `/identity/session`, `/identity/memberships`, `/identity/applications*`, `/identity/operator/*`. operationIds do not change.
- **Disabled association (ADR-0007), changed in run 2:** the allow-list that stays open is `searchRegistry`, `getSignedProtocol` and `downloadFile` for files pinned by a signed snapshot (AC-26). Every other moved governance and finance operation, reads included, adds `identity.association_disabled` to its 403 (use `MemberOrDisabled`), the same as the association-scoped identity operations of this delta. Run 1 named only the operations that change data; ADR-0007 refuses everything outside the allow-list.
- **Roster marks (AC-20):** the web app matches `BoardMember.decision_id` to `AssociationCard.history[].decision_id` and shows `filed_at`, `occurred_at` and the extract (`downloadConfirmationExtract` with `extract_id`); the roster page reads the card as well.
- **Operator contact (AC-05):** not in the API. The address is a build setting of the web app; break-tasks names the variable and the task that shows it on the «my applications» page.
- **Storage not connected (AC-28):** `addCaseDocument` and `createAssistantTurn` add 409 `governance.drive_not_connected` («Спершу підключіть сховище документів ОСББ»); add the example and the code to `governance/domain` ErrorRegistry.
- **Security:** scheme already present; no change.
- **Handler methods to add (identity):** ListMemberships, ListMyApplications, FileApplication, GetMyApplication, RefileApplication, DownloadMyExtract, ListApplicationsForReview, GetApplicationForReview, DownloadExtractForReview, RecordExtractCheck, ApproveApplication, RejectApplication, ListAssociationsForOperator, DisableAssociation, EnableAssociation, GetAssociationCard, DownloadConfirmationExtract, GetStorageConnection, CompleteStorageConnection, StartStorageConnection (GetSession exists, its response changes).
- **Problem codes handlers must set in `code`:** every `identity.*` code of PRD §5.1 listed in `x-problem-types`, plus `governance.drive_not_connected` on the governance side.
- **Async:** no River job (SAD §4 target surfaces have no worker), so no `events.md`.
